title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file
description: Three patch_file calls failed on src/moeb/internal/skills/run.skill.md: (1) diff header '--- a/path' treated as removed line rather than file header; (2) pure insertion diff (no removed lines) failed with 'all context lines appear in the file'; (3) same failure on retry with corrected line-number context. The operation was recovered via write_file.
proposed_resolution: Fix patch_file.rs to correctly apply hunks where orig_count is 0 (pure insertion). Alternatively, update run.skill.md to direct agents to use write_file for pure-insertion changes.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (large MCP result files)
description: Used Claude Code's external Read tool 5 times to access oversized MCP tool result files (mcp-moeb-start_run and mcp-moeb-grep_files outputs saved to .txt paths by the MCP result size limiter). No moeb equivalent exists for reading truncated MCP tool results. This caused a moeb-tool-origin rubric failure.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a kernel mechanism that handles oversized tool results inline, eliminating the need for external file reads.

title: patch_file does not support pure-insertion unified diffs
description: patch_file consistently fails when the diff contains only added lines (+) with no removed lines (-). The tool requires at least one removed line to successfully apply the hunk. This forces agents to fall back to write_file for pure insertions, increasing token usage and generating tool-error signals.
proposed_resolution: Fix patch_file.rs to apply hunks where orig_count is 0 by anchoring on following context lines.

title: run.skill.md should direct agents to use write_file for pure-insertion changes
description: Phase 3 recommends patch_file for changes under ~20 lines but does not distinguish pure insertions (no removed lines) from modifications. Three tool errors were incurred before falling back to write_file.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to Phase 3: for pure insertions (no lines removed), use write_file instead of patch_file.
